instruction: I am collecting contact information for professors and have their homepage links in this spreadsheet. Help me fill in the email addresses for all three professors by visiting their websites.

metadata.explanation: Task requires filling email addresses for three professors (Qi Liu, Tao Yu, Lingpeng Kong) by visiting their websites. Evaluator checks exact email values in cells F3, F4, F5. Expected emails verified from gold file: liuqi@cs.hku.hk, tao.yu.nlp@gmail.com, lpk@cs.hku.hk.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Full credit (1.0) requires all three email addresses to be correct. Score is proportional: 0/3 = 0.0, 1/3 = 0.33, 2/3 = 0.67, 3/3 = 1.0

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all three required email cells (F3, F4, F5)
Correct state extraction: Getter reads the exact cells where emails should be filled
Logical comparison: Metric uses exact string matching appropriate for email verification
Proper partial credit: Proportional scoring correctly implemented (0.33 per correct email)
Appropriate postconfig: Saves file before verification to ensure changes are persisted
Correct expected values: Email addresses verified from gold file and semantically correct
Robust implementation: Getter properly handles file transfer from VM and cleanup
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider trimming whitespace from cell values before comparison to handle accidental spaces
Could add case-insensitive email comparison (though current strict matching is acceptable)
